card.name: Words after a quantity-setting phrase
card.fires_on: Quantity words such as "of" after "number", "mg" after a dose figure, and adjectives like "lower", "larger", "narrow" or "adequate" after "a" or "the". They sit just before a noun for an amount, rate or range.
